subject: EdgeScale dedicated sizing request — capacity brokerage & tranche proposal
messages:
From: Lauren Smith <lauren@edgescale.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity request — production rollout June 28

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the intro. We're planning a GA rollout for our latency-sensitive vector search model on June 28. Based on our benchmarking we'd need a dedicated tranche of ~8x A100-equivalent GPUs (8k tokens concurrency peak), with steady-state window 6am–12pm PT weekdays and a small evening burst.

I've attached a brief requirements spreadsheet (EdgeScale_prod_requirements.xlsx) and our expected traffic curve.

Can Redwood commit to a dedicated tranche starting by Jun 21? We can finalize commercials quickly — approvals are in process.

Best,
Lauren
Head of ML Ops
EdgeScale

Attachment: EdgeScale_prod_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 54KB)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Lauren Smith <lauren@edgescale.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-15T10:03:12-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — production rollout June 28

Hi Lauren — thanks for the details and the attachment.

Quick note: we have a committed Dedicated customer (Asteria Media) with tranche allocations that overlap portions of your requested window in late June. I want to get you an accurate plan rather than over-promise — I'm looping in our capacity & renewals leads to map options (cc'd Marissa).

Can we lock a 30-min call tomorrow to run through the traffic shape and SLAs? In parallel I'll push a snapshot of our pool availability.

- Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-15T11:41:00-07:00
Subject: RE: EdgeScale dedicated sizing request — capacity conflict with Asteria

Team —

EdgeScale (DL-2027-0897) is requesting 8 A100-equivalent GPUs tranche starting Jun 21 for peak windows mornings PT; Asteria (DL-2026-1145) currently holds a committed tranche occupying the same pool with hard SLA (18k peak tokens/day) through Aug.

Options I see (pros/cons):
- Time-slicing: carve morning PT windows for EdgeScale and shift Asteria to evenings. Requires contractual change and may breach Asteria's SLA during business hours.
- Canary on shared pool with traffic shaping: get EdgeScale live earlier with rate caps; protects current commitments but not full performance.
- Swap tranches: offer Asteria a compensatory credit & move them to a different physical GPU pool (migration ops cost).
- Expand capacity (burst): temporarily stand up a short-term burst (reserved spot instances) — higher cost but simplest for customer timelines.

Attached current_pools_snapshot.csv shows the exact GPU assignments and utilization for the affected clusters.

Recommend: offer EdgeScale a short canary (shared + strict qps) to meet Jun28 must-have while we negotiate tranche swap or a paid burst. If we prioritize purely by ARR, Asteria > EdgeScale; but sales/CS prefers keeping both engaged.

Thoughts?

- Aditya

Attachment: current_pools_snapshot.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-15T12:05:22-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: EdgeScale dedicated sizing request — capacity conflict with Asteria

Aditya —

We can't reassign Asteria's committed tranche without a clear financial offset. Asteria is a strategic enterprise (multi-year, ARR > $1.2M) and has SLOs tied to business hours. I'm aligned with a two-track: 1) short-term canary on shared pool (must include strict observability & auto-fallback to prevent noisy neighbor impact), 2) prepare a paid burst or dedicated ephemeral tranche for EdgeScale while we work on a longer-term tranche swap with credits.

If we do a swap, we should have an escalation packet ready: legal-approved credit terms, migration timeline, and an ops runbook. Karthik — please coordinate groove with renewals/Legal.

Marissa
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-15T13:20:10-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: EdgeScale dedicated sizing request — capacity conflict with Asteria

Ack. I'll draft the escalation packet. Preliminary negotiation points:
- Offer Asteria a 6% credit for a partial tranche shift + guaranteed migration window in 6 weeks.
- Offer EdgeScale a 4-week paid burst at premium (x1.6) to meet May/Jun launch, with option to convert to a dedicated tranche for Q3.

We should also evaluate if we can shift Asteria's non-critical nightly batch jobs to another cluster — ops, can we get a feasiblity estimate?

Karthik
Director, Sales Ops

Attachment: pricing_tranche_terms.pdf (PDF, 82KB)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Lauren Smith <lauren@edgescale.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-15T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity request — proposed path forward

Hi Lauren — quick update and proposal: 

1) Short-term: Canary launch on shared pool with enforced QPS/token caps + dedicated monitoring. This lets you go live June 28 at reduced peak throughput (we'll baseline performance and loosen caps post-metrics).
2) Mid-term: We will provision a paid burst tranche (4 weeks) at premium pricing to cover your full performance window starting immediately after canary, if you sign the attached Tarif Order (pricing_tranche_terms.pdf).
3) Long-term: Target a dedicated tranche for Q3 (formal tranche allocation after we finalize migration and swap terms with Asteria). We will provide a credit offset if tranche swap is executed.

Next steps: please confirm that canary + paid burst is acceptable and I'll send a short engagement PO/quote to expedite provisioning.

Thanks — Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_tranche_terms.pdf (PDF, 82KB)
